messages:
Alex Kim: quick handoff — primary -> Maria for night. Summary of what happened earlier (03:12 UTC): pagestorm triggered for embeddings service (redwood-mini-embedding, us-west). Autoscaler started oscillating after a bad leader election; we saw ~12% 5xx for 09:00–09:18 PT. Page rot (incident-bot) fired twice. Action taken: rolled the autoscaler deployment to previous stable revision, temporarily increased replica count by +30% to absorb backlog, and enabled a soft-fallback to smaller model variant for 2 hostpools. Customer impact: roughly 2% of embedding requests failed or timed out (mostly long sequences). No broad data loss. Key links: Grafana dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/embeds/embed-slo, runbook: https://wiki.redwood/internal/runbooks/embeddings-autoscaler.

incident-bot: INCIDENT SUMMARY: pages=3; first_page=8076539520; sev=2; affected_service=redwood-mini-embedding; region=us-west; symptom=5xx-spike; current_state=monitoring; runbook_step=scale-rollback. Logs snapshot: `error: autoscaler leader lost lease, scale-to-zero race`.

Maria Gomez: thanks alex — are we fully stable? what are current p95/p99 for latency & 5xx rates?

Alex Kim: p95 latency normalized to baseline (~220ms) but p99 still elevated (1.6s vs 1.2s baseline). 5xx sliding window now ~0.5% (was 12%). No new pages in last 45m. I left the replica bump in place until morning unless you want to revert. Also left canary routing disabled for two critical routes.

Devon Patel: copying the immediate command set I used to inspect pods and logs — use if you need to re-run checks quickly.

Devon Patel: ```
# inspect autoscaler deployment
kubectl -n inference get deploy embeddings-autoscaler -o wide
# see recent events
kubectl -n inference get events --sort-by=.metadata.creationTimestamp | tail -n 50
# grab logs from the leader
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/embeddings-autoscaler -c controller --since=30m | grep -i lease
```

Devon Patel: short log snippet we saw:

Devon Patel: ```
2026-03-18T03:12:07Z WARN controller leader lost lease id=autoscaler-3a
2026-03-18T03:12:09Z ERROR scale decision failed: found 0 backends, aborting
2026-03-18T03:12:10Z INFO reconciliation: rolling back to revision 2026-02-28-9
```

Kevin Liu: flagging coverage gap — our assigned secondary (Priya) has a personal outage window tonight 20:00–02:00 PT (calendar note). We need a backup secondary for that slot. Maria, can you take secondary between 22:00–02:00 PT if we get a late regression?

Maria Gomez: I can take 22:00–02:00 PT. If anything pages earlier, I'll triage with Alex until the handover at 22.

Priya Rao: will own the incident ticket & postmortem follow-up. I'll open INC-4432 with timeline + root cause hypothesis (autoscaler leader election + lease TTL misconfig). I'll also add the #postmortem checklist.

Priya Rao: INC ticket draft notes: "detected leader lease loss causing concurrent scale-downs; rollback performed; mitigation: bump lease TTL and add leader fencing; long-term: controller fix + resilience tests." Assigned to infra-team (owner: infra-autoscale).

Alex Kim: outstanding action items before I go offline:
- Alex Kim: confirm canary routing stays disabled (done)
- Priya Rao: create INC-4432 + link to runbook (in progress)
- Devon Patel: add unit/regression test for leader election flakiness (owner)
- Infra team: revert temporary replica bump after 24h if stable; otherwise propose plan (owner: infra-autoscale)

Maria Gomez: I'll monitor dashboards for the next 6 hours and alert if p99 > 2.0s or 5xx > 1%. Pager rules to use: page SRE primary (oncall-sre) for immediate 5xx > 3% or p95 latency > 500ms sustained > 5m.

Alex Kim: small personal note for the night team — if you need to reproduce load locally, use the stress script in tools/bench/embeds_stress.sh with `-qps 200` and sequence length 2048. Don't forget to set `ENV=staging`.

Maria Gomez: thanks — I'll take primary. Kevin, thanks for flagging coverage. Priya — please ping infra lead (sasha@infra) and drop a quick Slack note in #infra-autoscale for visibility.

Kevin Liu: done — pinged Sasha and left a note in #infra-autoscale with the INC link once Priya posts it. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: MONITORING CHECK: no new pages for 46m; 5xx rate trending down; alert threshold not breached. Next automated check in 15m.

Priya Rao: leaving a runbook pointer for future oncalls: https://wiki.redwood/internal/runbooks/embeddings-autoscaler#leader-election — follow steps 2,4,6 for quick rollback. If you need to escalate to SEV1, ping oncall-sre + infra manager.

Maria Gomez: wrap-up for handoff — current status = monitoring, mitigations applied (rollback + replica bump + canary disabled), next steps = create postmortem (Priya), infra fix (owner assigned), monitor p99 for 12h. No active customer escalations open. I'll post a short status update to #product-support at 22:15 PT.

Alex Kim: thanks team — leaving. Maria is primary, Kevin backup until 22:00, then Maria covers. Priya owns followups. Good handoff. :wave:
